verdict.rationale: Buzz documents its own automation surfaces: YAML-as-code automation with traces, workflows that can be triggered and approved from the CLI, and remote agents that run headless on a substrate such as Kubernetes and respond to @mentions through the relay. However, the docs show only manual or mention-driven triggers and say little about how automations are defined or run unattended, so autonomous background execution is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented recurring/scheduled or event-driven automation triggers, detail on authoring and running YAML workflows unattended, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
